items.justification: Statement 3 is typed FACT and says GET and DELETE use a querystring schema that includes taskIdParamsSchema. The code contradicts this: taskIdParamsSchema is attached as `params` on GET /tasks/:id (fixtures/task-api/src/routes/tasks.routes.ts:20) and on DELETE, which has no querystring schema at all (fixtures/task-api/src/routes/tasks.routes.ts:30). Because a FACT statement is judged false, the verdict is incorrect regardless of statement 4, which is also an error since filtering and sorting are done by applyFilters and sortTasks (fixtures/task-api/src/services/task.filters.ts:10), not by the schema (fixtures/task-api/src/schemas/pagination.schema.ts:15).

Statement 1 is typed INFERENCE and claims only that the valid transitions are defined in src/domain/task-status.ts. Its cited lines back that inference: they are in that file, and the rule that decides validity is written there, in canTransition (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:26) and allowedTransitions (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:30), both reading the module-local TRANSITIONS table (fixtures/task-api/src/domain/task-status.ts:13). Statements 2 to 4 are true by agreement of both panelists, with the illegal transition thrown at fixtures/task-api/src/services/task.service.ts:50, so every statement is true.
